publisher: Ministero dell'Università e della Ricerca (MUR) with the Ministero degli Affari Esteri (MAECI)
claim: There is no national application deadline: outside numero programmato courses, each institution sets and publishes its own pre-enrolment dates. The visa and residence-permit procedures do not apply to EU citizens. Italian tertiary education includes universities, AFAM institutions (art, music, dance), Scuole Superiori per Mediatori Linguistici and ITS Academy, which are applied to directly.
excerpt: I termini previsti per le procedure relative alle preiscrizioni ai corsi di studio, ad eccezione di quelli a numero programmato, sono definiti da ogni singola Istituzione della formazione superiore e pubblicati nei rispettivi siti. […] le sole procedure relative al rilascio del visto di ingresso e del relativo permesso di soggiorno non si applicano: d) ai cittadini appartenenti ai Paesi dell'Unione Europea
interpretation: The document is written for visa applicants, and most of it does not concern an EU/EEA student: Universitaly pre-enrolment is for non-EU applicants who need a visa. What it establishes for an EU applicant is the absence of a central system — you apply on each university's own portal on its own calendar. The same circular names the sectors (università, AFAM, SSML, ITS Academy) and says ITS Academy candidates apply directly to the ITS, which is why the sector landscape cites it. It is explicitly valid for two academic years, 2026-27 and 2027-28, so it does cover autumn 2027 entry.

claim: Bocconi runs two selection sessions for 2027-28 entry: Early, 2–29 September 2026, and Winter, 25 November 2026 – 26 January 2027, both closing at 15:00 Italian time. The last Winter Session online test date is 21 January 2027.
excerpt: Early Session: 2 - 29 September 2026 (3:00pm Italian time) […] Winter Session: 25 November 2026 - 26 January 2027 (3:00pm Italian time) […] Winter session final test date: 21 January 2027
interpretation: The thing a student gets wrong: Bocconi closes its last 2027 round in January 2027, four months before the IB exams, and there is no spring round for 2027-28. A student planning to apply 'after predictions' in spring has already missed it. You need a test score (Bocconi online test, SAT, ACT or LSAT) before you can submit.

attestation.note: Page stated there are two sessions for 2027-28, Early and Winter. The Early Session had already closed on the day of reading.

publisher: CISIA (Consorzio Interuniversitario Sistemi Integrati per l'Accesso)
claim: A TOLC entrance test can be sat once a month per type, from February to November, and costs €35. Each university's own admission notice sets which sitting counts for its round.
excerpt: Puoi sostenere un TOLC dello stesso tipo ogni mese. […] Puoi fare il TOLC da febbraio a novembre […] Il TOLC costa 35 euro
interpretation: There is no single TOLC date to put in a calendar, which is why the milestone carries a declared state rather than a date. The practical advice follows from the once-a-month rule: sit it early, so a bad result can be retaken before the university's round closes.

claim: At San Raffaele an IB Diploma needs no Declaration of Value or Statement of Comparability and no translation, but must be apostilled; the DP Course Results certificate alone is not sufficient.
